facts.fact: UNFPA DRC reports that the national statistics institute (INS) and UNFPA held a technical workshop in Kinshasa on 4-5 December 2023 on producing vital statistics from civil registration, which adopted a roadmap to draft a methodological guide and an action plan.
The workshop concerns statistics on births, deaths, marriages and divorces from the civil registration system, which the document says the national statistical system struggles to produce.
